notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional Kithkin.
description:
Cast Kinsbaile Borderguard by paying {1}{W}{W}, causing it to enter the battlefield with at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Antler Skulkin by paying {2}, giving Kinsbaile Borderguard persist until end of turn.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Kinsbaile Borderguard, adding {C}{C}.
When Kinsbaile Borderguard dies, its persist ability triggers, as well as its second ability.
Resolve the second trigger, creating a number of 1/1 Kithkin Soldier creature tokens equal to the number of counters on Kinsbaile Borderguard.
Resolve the first trigger, returning it to the battlefield from your graveyard with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to its ability.
Repeat.
